messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'm scheduling the tenant partition swap migration during tonight's quiet window (23:00 UTC). Deploybot will run preflight checks at +5m. Please read the rollout/rollback matrix below.

deploybot: preflight started for migration aws:tenant_partition_swap:v2
- checking locks
- checking replica lag
- validating canary job
preflight results: OK (locks:0, lag<5s, canary: pass)

maria: Can we pin the service image to 2024.4.1 for this migration? last time the latest image introduced subtle schema client mismatch.

sam: Yes pin to 2024.4.1. @deploybot please use image tag 2024.4.1 for canary and main rollout.

deploybot: pinned image 2024.4.1 for deployment pipeline.

jia: Canary plan: run on 10 tenants (low traffic), validate inserts/reads + KV cache hitrate. If any transient lock > 500ms observed on >3 tenants, abort.

oliver: Add latency rollback clause: if canary p95 write latency > baseline p95 * 1.4 or error rate > 0.5% => abort and rollback.

oncall_sre: Also add replica-lag abort: if replica lag > 30s during canary => abort. I’ll be paged if that happens.

sam: OK updating runbook — adding these three abort conditions. Also add an escape hatch: manual holdpoint at 23:15 UTC. If anything anomalous, @sam will trigger `deploybot hold --thread 1758203001`.

maria: For rollbacks, we revert the schema flag and run reverse backfill job: `jobs/reverse_tenant_swap --tenants $CANARY_TENANTS` (low priority). Manual DB restore not expected.

sam: Quick commands for oncall:
```bash
# abort and rollback
deploybot abort --reason "canary-failure" --rollback true --image-tag 2024.4.1
# place hold
deploybot hold --thread 1758203001
```

jia: I'll monitor canary dashboards (write/error/locks) and post a short status every 5m in this thread.

deploybot: canary started (10 tenants). logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/canary/1758203001

sam: Thanks — reconvene at 23:20 for final decision. :thumbsup:

maria: Good to go from product-side if canary passes basic checks. :white_check_mark:

oncall_sre: I'll be watching alerts and tracer spikes. If I see >2 pager events, I'll call abort.

oliver: Note: migration includes a non-blocking index add after the row rewrite. If rewrite time per tenant > 15m, abort and schedule follow-up run.

jia: First 5m update: no errors, avg write p95 +2% baseline, replica lag 1-3s. continuing.

jia: 10m update: one tenant saw transient lock ~600ms but did not fail; still under thresholds. no action.

sam: Keep monitoring. If all green at 23:20, we'll proceed to full rollout with 5m stagger.

deploybot: canary complete — result: PASS

sam: Proceeding to staggered rollout in 5m. triggering pipeline.

maria: Confirmed. I'll update release notes with pinned image and rollback steps.

oncall_sre: Noted, standing by.

oliver: If anything degrades, we follow rollback matrix above. Good luck.

sam: Closing thread — I'll post final status when rollout done.
